title: Strategic Distribution Partner - Brazil (Cardiology / Heart Failure)
description:
Acorai is preparing to expand into the Brazilian market and is seeking a best-in-class strategic distribution partner in Brazil to lead commercialization of its next-generation, non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring solution for heart failure care pathways.What we’re looking for

We’re interested in partnering with an established Brazilian medical device distributor/importer that can:

  • Drive adoption in cardiology/heart failure across key hospital networks
  • Provide clinical education & field support (KOL development, onboarding, workflow integration)
  • Handle service/logistics and post-market processes at hospital-grade standards
  • Navigate local commercialization realities (procurement, tenders where relevant, hospital committees)
What a partnership could look like
  • Territory: Brazil (exclusive potential)
  • Structure: Performance-based exclusivity with clear milestones
  • Launch approach: Pilot-site activation + clinical education + structured scale-up plan
  • Alignment: Long-term partnership orientation with shared execution focus
Who should reach out
  • Distributor principals / CEOs / GMs
  • Leaders of cardiology-focused distributor groups
  • Regional medtech operators with a strong hospital network and commercialization engine
Next steps

If this matches your organization, message us with:

  • Your company overview + therapeutic focus
  • Coverage footprint (cities/states) and sales/service organization
  • 2–3 examples of similar hospital-launched products you’ve scaled
  • Your view on a 6–12 month launch plan in Brazil

title: Bilingual Recruiter Assistant
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote

At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.

This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.

What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding

Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines

Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace

Build Your Career in Recruitment

If you want to work directly with U.S. teams, gain valuable recruiting experience, and grow fast in a structured and performance-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.

Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: Strategic Distribution Partner – Brazil (Cardiology / Heart Failure)
description:
Acorai is preparing to expand into the Brazilian market and is seeking a best-in-class strategic distribution partner in Brazil to lead commercialization of its next-generation, non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring solution for heart failure care pathways.

What we’re looking for

We’re interested in partnering with an established Brazilian medical device distributor/importer that can:

  • Drive adoption in cardiology/heart failure across key hospital networks
  • Provide clinical education & field support (KOL development, onboarding, workflow integration)
  • Handle service/logistics and post-market processes at hospital-grade standards
  • Navigate local commercialization realities (procurement, tenders where relevant, hospital committees)
What a partnership could look like
  • Territory: Brazil (exclusive potential)
  • Structure: Performance-based exclusivity with clear milestones
  • Launch approach: Pilot-site activation + clinical education + structured scale-up plan
  • Alignment: Long-term partnership orientation with shared execution focus
Who should reach out
  • Distributor principals / CEOs / GMs
  • Leaders of cardiology-focused distributor groups
  • Regional medtech operators with a strong hospital network and commercialization engine
Next steps

If this matches your organization, message us with:

  • Your company overview + therapeutic focus
  • Coverage footprint (cities/states) and sales/service organization
  • 2–3 examples of similar hospital-launched products you’ve scaled
  • Your view on a 6–12 month launch plan in Brazil

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js/JavaScript) — E-commerce
description:
About firmly

firmly solutions turn moments of product discovery (AI, social, content, ads, messaging, etc.) into instant purchases through its agentic commerce platform — with fast, embedded checkout and a strong focus on security and reliability.

If you enjoy building high-performance APIs, working on distributed systems, and shipping cloud-native solutions with real-world scale and constraints, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve backend services and APIs in Node.js/JavaScript for critical e-commerce/checkout flows.
  • Develop edge/serverless systems on Cloudflare Workers (e.g., Workers and related services) focused on low latency, resilience, and scalability.
  • Design and implement partner integrations (APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows) and near real-time data sync (e.g., pricing, inventory, order status).
  • Improve observability (logs/metrics/tracing), incident readiness, and operational excellence (“you build it, you run it”).
  • Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD improvements, and pragmatic architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Partnerships, Data) and contribute as a technical leader/mentor within the team.

Required skills & experience

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer building production-grade backends with Node.js/JavaScript.
  • Solid experience designing and operating APIs (REST and/or event-driven systems) with a quality mindset.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Workers (Workers and other services) OR strong serverless/edge background and willingness to go deep on Cloudflare.
  • Good foundation in data modeling and databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for transactional systems.
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals (authN/authZ, secrets management, least privilege, secure-by-default design).
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) — you’ll collaborate with a global team and participate in meetings/doc reviews in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with payments, checkout, fraud/risk, or other mission-critical e-commerce systems.
  • Event-driven architectures, async processing, queues/streams.
  • Performance/latency optimization, caching, edge patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Cloudflare Workers tooling (Wrangler); plus modern DevOps practices.

Benefits & Career Growth

  • Unimed Nacional health plan (coverage for spouse/partner and children).
  • Meal and food allowance (VR/VA).
  • Life insurance.
  • UniOdonto dental plan.
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities (mentorship, ownership, and room to grow with the team).
  • Clear growth path (regular feedback and performance cycles).
  • Ownership & autonomy (high-impact work, end-to-end responsibility).
  • Learning & development support.

How to apply

Click Easy Apply on LinkedIn and attach your resume (PDF).

  • Tip: parts of the interview process may be conducted in English.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for \"Full Stack Developer\" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Desenvolvedor React & JavaScript Vanilla Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Frontend Pleno com foco em React e JavaScript Vanilla para atuar na construção e evolução de aplicações web escaláveis e de alto impacto. O conhecimento em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) é um diferencial , mas caso ainda não tenha tido contato, é importante ter interesse em aprender e evoluir nessa stack.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces web com React e JavaScript Vanilla
  • Criar interações diretas manipulando o DOM quando necessário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST
  • Construir componentes reutilizáveis com foco em performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e discussões de solução
  • Atuar em code reviews e apoiar na qualidade do código do time
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, com comunicação clara


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência com React e JavaScript
  • Domínio de React: hooks, estado, componentização e performance
  • Forte base em JavaScript Vanilla: DOM, eventos e consumo de APIs sem frameworks
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo
  • Autonomia, foco e organização
  • Conhecimento em HTML semântico e CSS moderno
  • Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com AEM, caso ainda não tenha experiência


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com AEM (Adobe Experience Manager)


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Técnico de telecomunicações
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global. Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Perfil: Técnico Telecom

Jornada de Trabalho: Segunda a Sexta - 07:00 às 16:00 (Necessário disponibilidade para plantão mediante escala e regime de sobre aviso após horário)

Local de trabalho: Rodovia Do Sol - Município: Anchieta.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar na implantação, operação e manutenção de soluções de telecomunicações.
  • Executar atividades de cabeamento estruturado, incluindo passagem, organização e certificação.
  • Realizar passagem, fusão e conectorização de fibra óptica.
  • Montar, organizar e realizar a arrumação de racks, garantindo padronização e qualidade.
  • Configurar e operar switches e access points Cisco, conforme projetos e padrões técnicos.
  • Operar e dar suporte a equipamentos de telefonia, PABX e videoconferência.
  • Acompanhar, controlar e inspecionar a execução de projetos de telecom, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, escopo e normas técnicas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, avaliando projetos e propondo melhorias técnicas quando necessário.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam em conformidade com as normas técnicas de telecomunicações.
  • Apoiar equipes técnicas e fornecedores durante as execuções em campo.
  • Participar de plantões em escala e atuar em regime de sobreaviso quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo nas ares de Tecnologia da Informação, Telecomunicações, Redes de Computadores, Engenharia de Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas
  • Ter conhecimento especifico do funcionamento dos equipamentos CISCO.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

title: Representante comercial de vendas
description:
Representante de Vendas – Food Service | Utilidades Profissionais e Domésticas

Chef Line Inox

Sobre a Chef Line

A Chef Line é uma marca e importadora de utilidades domésticas e institucionais, com forte atuação no segmento de food service.

Nosso portfólio inclui utensílios de cozinha para preparo e serviço, cutelaria, opaline, talheres, cubas GN, botijões térmicos, cafeteiras elétricas, panelas aquecedoras, réchauds elétricos e a fogareiro, além de outros produtos profissionais, com certificação Inmetro quando aplicável e garantia.

Desde 2017, fornecemos soluções para cozinhas profissionais em todo o Brasil.

Escritório em Itajaí (SC) e Centro de Distribuição em São José (SC), com entrega nacional.

Atendemos atacados, distribuidores, lojistas, supermercados e canais de marketplace, com portfólio de alto giro.

Contamos com política de parcelamento, frete CIF para diversas regiões, equipe interna dedicada e aplicativo próprio para gestão de pedidos e informações de produto.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos contratando Representantes de Vendas para todos os estados do Brasil.

  • Atuação com região definida, conforme alinhamento comercial.

  • Realizar visitas e atendimento à carteira ativa
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais
  • Gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes
  • Acompanhar pedidos, pós-venda e relacionamento comercial
  • Utilizar as ferramentas e o aplicativo da empresa no dia a dia comercial

Qualificações

  • Experiência em vendas externas ou representação comercial
  • CNPJ ativo para representação
  • Carteira de clientes ativos
  • Não atuar com pastas conflitantes
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e focado em relacionamento comercial

title: Observability Engineer - PL/SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Observability Engineer – PL/SR para atuar no desenho, implementação e operação de soluções de observabilidade, garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta dos ambientes, aplicações e serviços em arquiteturas híbridas e multicloud.

Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e manter pipelines de telemetria para logs, métricas e traces ;
  • Desenvolver e operar a infraestrutura responsável pela coleta, processamento e roteamento de dados de observabilidade;
  • Arquitetar, implementar e operar a plataforma de observabilidade baseada no Grafana Stack ;
  • Integrar soluções de observabilidade em ambientes híbridos e multicloud , suportando diferentes tipos de workloads;
  • Trabalhar com ambientes containerizados e orquestrados com Kubernetes ;
  • Integrar observabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps ;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de plataforma, SRE e desenvolvimento para evolução contínua das soluções.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência com Grafana Stack (arquitetura, implementação e operação);
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de observabilidade (Logs, Metrics e Traces);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) e GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota o fuso horário de Portugal

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenTelemetry;
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em SRE ou engenharia de confiabilidade.

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Analytics & AI Lab, um squad multifuncional responsável por desenvolver algoritmos avançados e soluções de IA aplicadas a dados de retail media e comércio.

O squad atua como uma unidade de P&D e IA aplicada, construindo algoritmos que são:

  • alimentados por múltiplas fontes internas de dados;
  • expostos por meio de APIs;
  • consumidos por produtos, times de analytics e stakeholders de negócio.

Todo o ecossistema é construído sobre a Google Cloud Platform, com forte integração entre engenharia de dados, analytics engineering e desenvolvimento de IA.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Scientist, sua missão será desenhar, desenvolver e operacionalizar algoritmos de machine learning e IA que gerem valor de negócio em contextos de retail media. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analytics engineers, data engineers e times de produto para transformar dados brutos em soluções preditivas, prescritivas e inteligentes, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e explicabilidade.



Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de IA & Machine Learning

  • Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos de machine learning e algoritmos de IA;
  • Conduzir P&D de algoritmos de IA, da fase exploratória até soluções prontas para produção;
  • Selecionar abordagens de modelagem adequadas (estatísticas, ML, deep learning) conforme o problema de negócio.

Dados & Feature Engineering

  • Consumir dados do BigQuery e de camadas analíticas curadas;
  • Definir e criar features em parceria com os times de analytics e engenharia de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, relevância e consistência dos dados para modelagem.

Implantação e Integração de Modelos

  • Empacotar modelos e algoritmos para exposição via APIs;
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para implantação em ambientes produtivos;
  • Monitorar performance dos modelos, drift e necessidades de reentreinamento.

Casos de Uso em Retail Media

  • Desenvolver modelos relacionados a:
  • previsão de demanda;
  • performance de campanhas;
  • atribuição e uplift;
  • tráfego e conversão;
  • segmentação de audiências;
  • Traduzir KPIs de retail media e e-commerce em soluções orientadas por ML.

Colaboração & Trabalho em Squad

  • Atuar em um squad multicultural (Brasil + França), com comunicação diária em inglês;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com discussões técnicas, documentação e compartilhamento de conhecimento dentro do laboratório.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência com Python para data science e ML;
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de machine learning (supervisionados, não supervisionados, séries temporais etc.);
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados utilizando BigQuery;
  • Forte base em estatística e desenho experimental;
  • Experiência em expor modelos via APIs ou integrá-los a sistemas em produção.

Google Cloud & Stack de IA

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform;
  • Familiaridade com:
  • Vertex AI;
  • BigQuery ML;
  • Gemini / ferramentas de GenAI (prompting, embeddings, RAG ou similares);
  • Experiência com notebooks e fluxos de experimentação.



Habilidades Profissionais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidade para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de data science;
  • Excelente comunicação;
  • Inglês avançado (uso diário obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou retail media;
  • Experiência com práticas de MLOps (versionamento, monitoramento, reentreinamento);
  • Vivência em AI Labs ou squads de P&D;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de experimentação e testes A/B;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Forte autonomia e senso de ownership;
  • Confortável em ambientes exploratórios e com problemas ambíguos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar por meio de expertise técnica, não por hierarquia;
  • Perfil curioso, experimental e orientado a negócio.

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Analytics & AI Lab, um squad multifuncional responsável por desenvolver algoritmos avançados e soluções de IA aplicadas a dados de retail media e comércio.

O squad atua como uma unidade de P&D e IA aplicada, construindo algoritmos que são:

  • alimentados por múltiplas fontes internas de dados;
  • expostos por meio de APIs;
  • consumidos por produtos, times de analytics e stakeholders de negócio.

Todo o ecossistema é construído sobre a Google Cloud Platform, com forte integração entre engenharia de dados, analytics engineering e desenvolvimento de IA.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Scientist, sua missão será desenhar, desenvolver e operacionalizar algoritmos de machine learning e IA que gerem valor de negócio em contextos de retail media. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analytics engineers, data engineers e times de produto para transformar dados brutos em soluções preditivas, prescritivas e inteligentes, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e explicabilidade.



Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de IA & Machine Learning

  • Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos de machine learning e algoritmos de IA;
  • Conduzir P&D de algoritmos de IA, da fase exploratória até soluções prontas para produção;
  • Selecionar abordagens de modelagem adequadas (estatísticas, ML, deep learning) conforme o problema de negócio.

Dados & Feature Engineering

  • Consumir dados do BigQuery e de camadas analíticas curadas;
  • Definir e criar features em parceria com os times de analytics e engenharia de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, relevância e consistência dos dados para modelagem.

Implantação e Integração de Modelos

  • Empacotar modelos e algoritmos para exposição via APIs;
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para implantação em ambientes produtivos;
  • Monitorar performance dos modelos, drift e necessidades de reentreinamento.

Casos de Uso em Retail Media

  • Desenvolver modelos relacionados a:
  • previsão de demanda;
  • performance de campanhas;
  • atribuição e uplift;
  • tráfego e conversão;
  • segmentação de audiências;
  • Traduzir KPIs de retail media e e-commerce em soluções orientadas por ML.

Colaboração & Trabalho em Squad

  • Atuar em um squad multicultural (Brasil + França), com comunicação diária em inglês;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com discussões técnicas, documentação e compartilhamento de conhecimento dentro do laboratório.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência com Python para data science e ML;
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de machine learning (supervisionados, não supervisionados, séries temporais etc.);
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados utilizando BigQuery;
  • Forte base em estatística e desenho experimental;
  • Experiência em expor modelos via APIs ou integrá-los a sistemas em produção.

Google Cloud & Stack de IA

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform;
  • Familiaridade com:
  • Vertex AI;
  • BigQuery ML;
  • Gemini / ferramentas de GenAI (prompting, embeddings, RAG ou similares);
  • Experiência com notebooks e fluxos de experimentação.



Habilidades Profissionais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidade para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de data science;
  • Excelente comunicação;
  • Inglês avançado (uso diário obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote - Brazil)
description:
About the job

Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time

About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.

  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack
  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background
  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours

How to Apply

Apply here:

  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Especialista em Análise de Dados
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Alinhar a estratégia de dados aos objetivos do negócio, priorizando iniciativas de alto impacto e geração de valor.
  • Liderar projetos analíticos complexos, com desenvolvimento de modelos avançados e visualizações analíticas de alto nível.
  • Atuar como referência técnica na área de dados, promovendo boas práticas e capacitando usuários para garantir autonomia analítica e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas, com experiência profissional entre 5 e 7 anos.
  • Sólida atuação em ambientes Cloud, pipelines de ETL complexos e otimização de consultas em SQL e Python, com perfil multiplicador de conhecimento.
  • Expertise avançada em ferramentas de BI e evolução de arquiteturas de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança e comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir análises técnicas em insights claros para stakeholders de negócio.


Nossos benefícios:


  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Auxílio Farmácia;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);
  • Bônus Anual

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Salesforce Release Manager with COPADO
description:
Fast Dolphin is an international staffing company with over two decades of experience specializing in recruiting bilingual and multilingual IT experts across the Americas as well as providing payroll and customized staffing solutions. Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.

We are currently looking for a Salesforce Release Manager to work in a Remote position for a 6+ month with possible extension job opportunity.

Job Title: Salesforce Release Manager

Location: Remote in LATAM

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 + months with possible extensions

Responsibilities

  • Acts as the liaison between Product Owners and Salesforce development teams
  • Ensures user stories are complete, tested, approved, and ready for release
  • Manages Salesforce deployments and release pipelines using Copado CI/CD
  • Enforces CI/CD best practices and release governance standards
  • Maintains complete, audit-ready technical and release documentation
  • Coordinates testing activities and release approvals
  • Plans and executes release cycles with a focus on quality and stability
  • Supports system maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Ensures scalability, compliance, and performance of Salesforce environments

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in IT, systems analysis, or application delivery
  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce Release Management
  • Strong understanding of business processes and how systems support them
  • Solid knowledge of Agile methodologies (Kanban preferred)
  • Experience working with SaaS applications and packaged software
  • Strong planning, estimation, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA SD / OTC is a plus
  • Knowledge of PriceFx is a plus

Languages :

  • English B2

If you fulfill these requirements and are interested in this position, please send your resume along with your availability to start in this project, to the following e-mail address:

IT Recruiting Master

Ft. Lauderdale, FL 33330

description:

title: German Translator - Localization Specialist
description:
We are currently looking for a German Localization Specialist to join our global team.


Your work is to provide localization services for the short commands/data sets by verifying the correctness of the grammatical/pronunciation of the provided linguistic data sets. The tasks may include voice recording, adjustments of the data set in a software tool, transcription of the provided data set, and other work related to localizing the provided content.


The above description encapsulates the process referred to as “ Prompt Tuning.” When Prompt Tuning is performed, it requires actual native speakers to do the work, as their accent would be that of someone who grew up in the targeted country, spoke the local language as a first language, and is acquainted with the speech as spoken currently in a country of interest every day.


Experience:

Experience is important, but it's less about the years of experience and more about the skill set. However, a technical background is preferred (basic knowledge of, e.g., Notepad++, UX, Python, HTML, etc.). We are interested in people who can perform various tasks, but one of the important ones is Prompt Tuning. This requires excellent listening skills.


Requirements:

Having experience in localization is beneficial, and a background in linguistics is preferred.


Work Load:

The weekly workload will vary depending on the task. Sometimes, there will be 20 hours per week for several weeks, and later, another task will require 2 hours/week. It is on a project-by-project basis.


Training:

Full training will be provided, and our project team will guide you through the process.


Rate:

$13.75 per hour

Please send us your resume!

title: PE Deal Origination Associate
description:
Caprae Capital Partners


Caprae Capital Partners is a next-generation private equity and venture platform built by operators, not career financiers. Led by founder Kevin Hong , a serial tech entrepreneur who has scaled companies to $31M ARR and $7M in revenue , Caprae was formed alongside fellow entrepreneurs who have achieved eight-figure and nine-figure exits (including acquisitions by Twitter and Square ). The broader partner network includes a former NASA software engineer and a former Chief of Staff at Google, a team engineered for innovation and disruption.


Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae

This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .

  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed

title: Mainframe Project  Manager
description:
Job Description: Mainframe Project Manager – Remote

Location: LATAM

Rate: DOE


Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Manager to lead and oversee complex mainframe projects, ensuring successful execution and seamless integration with business processes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies , including zOS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX, and SAS , along with a strong background in project management, stakeholder management, risk assessment, and cost optimization . This role requires exceptional leadership skills to inspire teams, build relationships with stakeholders, and drive process improvements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, define project scope, set realistic timelines, and manage resources effectively.
  • Utilize expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies , including subsystems, JCL, COBOL, and REXX .
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end users .
  • Conduct risk assessments, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
  • Efficiently allocate resources, track expenses, and optimize costs while ensuring project success.
  • Provide leadership to project teams, fostering collaboration and setting clear direction.
  • Oversee project execution, ensuring alignment with defined project plans and timelines.
  • Maintain effective communication channels, manage stakeholder expectations, and address concerns promptly.
  • Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and ensure seamless vendor collaboration.
  • Assess the impact of mainframe migration on existing processes and workflows, ensuring smooth transitions.
  • Drive process improvements and implement best practices for change management .


Mandatory Skills and Proficiency Requirements:


  • zOS, AS400 – Advanced proficiency in mainframe operating systems.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX – Strong working knowledge of mainframe languages, job control, and scripting.
  • Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) – Demonstrated expertise in structured project management methodologies.
  • Project Management & Stakeholder Management – Strong ability to manage large-scale projects and engage with stakeholders effectively.
  • Risk Management & Vendor Relationship Management – Ability to assess and mitigate risks while maintaining vendor collaborations.
  • Change Management & Process Improvements – Proficiency in implementing change management strategies and driving process enhancements.
  • Team Management – Strong leadership skills to mentor, guide, and motivate technical teams.


Optional Skills and Proficiency Levels:

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL – Experience in database management on mainframe environments.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting – Experience in managing project finances, optimizing costs, and resource planning.

title: GenAI Data Scientist
description:
Job Details:

Job Title: GenAI Data Scientist

Exp- Minimum 8 years

  • 100% remote/Long Term Contract/EST hrs.


Job Role-

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will translate the needs of our cross-functional stakeholders into user-facing applications that leverage NLP techniques and large language models (LLMs). As a Sr. Data Scientist on our GenAI applications team, you will work on products like conversational search interfaces, chatbots, text summarizers, recommender engines, and more based on the needs of the constituents. You will partner with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, and cross-functional partners to develop production-grade algorithms.

You will contribute to the creation, delivery, and production of specific data science, machine learning and AI products for internal stakeholders; directly mentor other data professionals, data analysts, and machine learning engineers. In conjunction with the key partners, you will make technical decisions on data, technology, and ways of working

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect the overall framework and infrastructure for GenAI products like search interfaces, bots, summarizers, etc. Develop and implement techniques to optimize model performance to meet specific product goals
  • Collaborate closely with product management and engineering leads to align on technical roadmap. Guide engineering teams to effectively leverage LLM capabilities in product implementation.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation and business value. Proactively analyze latest developments in large language models to deeply understand model capabilities, limitations, and best practices. Develop techniques to continually improve language understanding and model training
  • Mentor and develop junior data scientists in state-of-the-art GenAI methods
  • Set technical vision and lead initiatives to accelerate product impact through cutting-edge LLM innovations
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Total Exp: 8 to 10yrs+
  • Advanced degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, statistics, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience in developing machine learning models with a track record of creating meaningful business impact and working with multiple stakeholders.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience with Python.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience building production NLP and deep learning models using PyTorch/Tensorflow, along with using large language model architectures (BERT, GPT-3 etc.)
  • Experience building advanced workflows such as retrieval augmented generation, model chaining, dynamic prompting, PEFT/SFT, etc. using Langchain and similar tools
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications
  • Proficiency with various prompting techniques, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs between prompting and finetuning
  • Experience with finetuning embedding models and tuning vector databases to improve performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Deep understanding of underlying fundamentals such as Transformers, Self-Attention mechanisms that form the theoretical foundation of LLMs
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms and tools (AWS).
  • Experience operationalizing end-to-end machine learning applications.

title: Web Designer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

*Experience writing and manipulating HTML

* Proficient in English, attentive to industry standards, and equipped with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficient with Figma for prototyping, sharing/testing designs

* Experience with utilizing a Design System

* Experience with front-end testing

*Experience working within a CMS to build webpages with components


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

*Experience in Adobe Creative suite (Photoshop)

* Experience contributing to a Design System

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager


Job Description

A BioTech client is seeking a Web Designer to join their team remotely in Brazil. This person will:

* Facilitate front-end content and code updates to the marketing website within Adobe Experience Manager

* Utilize brand guidelines and design system insights to build out new pages and experiences using existing code

* Collaborate closely with UX team to prototype intuitive experiences

* Source and manipulate imagery to create web-formatted graphics & banners

* Design layouts and templates for global solutions that focus on user experience

* Present design solutions to stakeholders and leadership

* Contribute to collaborative design sessions

* Support cross-browser testing at multiple stages of a project

* Evolve and build out the marketing site component and pattern libraries

** This role can pay up to $3,400 USD monthly

title: PMO – Projetos de Tecnologia e ERP
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a entregas para atuar como PMO com experiência em WMS, apoiando a gestão e governança de projetos de tecnologia e logística. Você será responsável por estruturar rotinas de acompanhamento, consolidar indicadores, organizar cronogramas e garantir a comunicação entre as áreas, contribuindo para a execução eficiente e a melhoria contínua dos projetos relacionados a Warehouse Management System (WMS).


Local

São Paulo/SP.


Modelo de trabalho

Remoto


Tipo de contratação

PJ


Responsabilidades

✅ Governança e Rotina de Projetos (PMO):

* Estruturar e conduzir rotinas de acompanhamento (status report, comitês, reuniões de alinhamento).

* Controlar e atualizar cronogramas, planos de ação, riscos, issues e dependências.

* Garantir aderência aos processos de governança e padrões de gestão definidos.


✅ Levantamento de Demandas e Requisitos (As Is):

• Realizar o mapeamento de demandas junto aos stakeholders, levantando requisitos funcionais e registrando o cenário atual (AS-IS).

• Documentar o fluxo básico dos processos e apoiar a organização das necessidades do negócio para evolução do projeto.


✅ Gestão de Indicadores e Relatórios:

* Consolidar KPIs do projeto (prazo, escopo, custos, qualidade e status de entregas).

* Elaborar dashboards e relatórios executivos para stakeholders, com clareza e objetividade.

* Apoiar na tomada de decisão por meio de análises e recomendações.


✅ Atuação com Projetos de WMS:

* Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de iniciativas envolvendo implantação, melhorias ou sustentação de WMS.

* Interagir com times de negócio (operações/logística) e TI para alinhamento de requisitos, prioridades e mudanças.

* Garantir rastreabilidade de demandas, entregáveis e documentação do projeto.


✅ Gestão de Stakeholders e Comunicação:

* Facilitar a comunicação entre áreas multidisciplinares, alinhando expectativas e prioridades.

* Apoiar a gestão de mudanças, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento das partes envolvidas.


✅ Qualidade, Testes e Go-live (quando aplicável):

* Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento de testes (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização.

* Organizar evidências, cronogramas e checkpoints para suportar a qualidade das entregas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

✔ Experiência prévia como PMO / Analista de Projetos / Project Analyst em projetos de TI.

✔ Experiência com WMS (implantação, melhorias, rollout ou sustentação), com vivência em ambiente de logística/armazenagem.

✔ Sólida capacidade de controle e gestão de: cronograma, riscos, issues, mudanças e dependências.

✔ Experiência com documentação e organização de entregáveis do projeto.

✔ Conhecimento em gestão de projetos (metodologias tradicionais e/ou ágeis).

✔ Perfil comportamental desejado:

* Organização e senso de dono para garantir cadência e execução.

* Proatividade para antecipar riscos e propor soluções.

* Comunicação clara para interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

* Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados.

* Colaboração com times multidisciplinares e ambientes dinâmicos.


Diferenciais

✚ Vivência com operações de armazém (recebimento, putaway, picking, packing, expedição, inventário).

✚ Experiência com integrações WMS x ERP (ex.: SAP, Oracle, TOTVS, etc.).

✚ Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão e indicadores (Jira/Confluence, MS Project, Power BI, Excel avançado).

✚ Certificações em gestão de projetos e métodos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban, ITIL).

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

description:
Role: Apps Architect

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract


13+ Years of development and app modernization experience. Experience in hosting and configuring the applications on IIS. Experience in modernization of Applications to Azure PaaS platform along with migration experience. Expertise in application hosting, configuration, optimization in various Azure PaaS services: Azure App service, Azure Functions, Aure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instance. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to find alternate ways to reach the goals. Ability to understand application architecture, dependencies, and integrations . Should have led and managed the team with the size more than 5 members. Should be able to guide the team technically. Very good understanding of application migration scenarios and pathways.


Primary skills:

  • Hands on web application development skills
  • Hands on experience in developing and hosting web applications on Azure PaaS platform
  • Primary database skills like database connectivity, configurations etc.
  • Ability to analyze application dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architect, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration Teams to ensure cloud adoption follows standard best practices.
  • Well versed with containerizing web application frontend and web services.
  • Should know the nitty-gritties of hosting containerized application on Kubernetes
  • Application performance assessment pre and post migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering business, application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design Azure Landing Zone and provide the Azure target state solution architecture.



Secondary Skills:

  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS platform
  • Basic understanding of containerization and AKS service
