title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.

Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?

Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.

About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.

Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 

Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.

Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview

Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form

Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: SDR - PRÉ VENDEDOR
description:
Descrição da Empresa Caf seguros faz parte do grupo ávila, empresa atuante no mercado financeiro: investimentos, credito e seguros.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um SDR - Pré Vendedor para integrar nossa equipe na CAF Seguros. O(a) profissional será responsável por identificar, qualificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de negócio, alimentar o pipeline de vendas e realizar o contato inicial com potenciais clientes. Além disso, deverá estabelecer uma comunicação eficaz para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e direcioná-los ao time de vendas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e desempenhado remotamente.

Qualificações

  • Vendas Internas e Geração de Leads: Experiência em vendas internas e identificação de potenciais clientes para gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento: Habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação para construir e manter bons relacionamentos com clientes e equipes internas.
  • Negócios e Desenvolvimento: Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de negócios e estratégias para impulsionar vendas e resultados.
  • Será um diferencial possuir experiência no setor de seguros, investimentos e crédito, conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e fluência em mais de um idioma.

title: Network Engineer
description:
The Network Engineer supports the IT infrastructure team by monitoring network systems, performing first-line troubleshooting, and assisting with network equipment maintenance and small deployments. This role provides an opportunity to learn and grow within a dynamic network operations environment.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor network performance using SolarWinds and escalate issues as needed.
  • Perform first-line network troubleshooting and resolve basic connectivity problems.
  • Contact Internet Service Providers (ISPs) for outage resolution and service coordination.
  • Assist in small-scale network deployments and configuration tasks.
  • Support the maintenance and documentation of Aruba switches and wireless controllers.
  • Assist with Fortinet firewall configurations and basic security monitoring.
  • Support Infoblox DDI operations including DNS, DHCP, and IPAM tasks.
  • Document network changes and maintain accurate records for compliance and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to ensure service continuity.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network engineering.
  • English (fluent) and Portuguese
  • Preferred: Aruba Certified (ACSA/ACSP), Fortinet NSE (Level 4+), Infoblox Certified Network Professional.
  • Specific knowledge of routing and switching protocols
  • Understanding of Networking concepts such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model and TCP/IP
  • Cisco CCNA certified (or equivalent network administration)
  • Aruba Switching and Wireless
  • Aruba Clearpass
  • MS Office 365 and ServiceNow
  • ITIL qualification
  • Experience participating in infrastructure projects and small-scale deployments.
  • Background in maintaining network equipment, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend (IA)
description:
Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software , de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Backend.

Conhecimentos Específicos Desejáveis:

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (cloudnative, web, microserviços);

- APIs REST;

- Banco de Dados SQL Relacionais (PostgreSQL, equivalentes);

- Testes Automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Karma ou equivalentes);

- DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar);

- Feature Flags e estratégias de deploy;

- Sistemas Distribuídos, Escalabilidade, Resiliência (nível intermediário);

- Mensageria (RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub ou equivalente);

- NoSQL (Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente);

- Cache (Redis);

- Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)(opcional)

- Orquestração de containers (Kubernetes)(opcional)

- Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage ou equivalente)

- Processamento distribuído (Hadoop, Spark)

- Pipelines de dados/streaming (Apache Beam, Dataflow, Airflow)

- Processamento assíncrono (Celery, Temporal IO)

- MCP (opcional)

- Copilot ou equivalente (opcional)

- Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes)

- Design Patterns

- Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros)

- APIFirts e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (CleanCode, etc...)

- Observabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações em produção (logs estruturados, métricas, traces)

- Metodologia Ágil

- Java avançado

- Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud

- Hibernate ou equivalente ORM

- Experiência em integrações complexas (REST APIs externas)

Certificações: Relacionadas a área como por exemplo Java, Spring, Python, Front-end ou Cloud Provider.

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)

Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.

Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.

You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.

Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.

Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.

Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)

Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.

Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.

You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.

Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.

Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.

Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional
description:
Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Months

This role will be SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration - experience is required.

Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

* Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

* Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

* Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

* Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

* Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

* Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

* Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

* Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

* Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

* Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

* Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

* Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

* Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

* Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

* Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

* Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

* Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

* Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

* Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.

Required Qualifications Experience

* 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

* Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

* Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

* Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

* Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

* Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

* Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.

Soft Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

* Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

* Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

* Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

They have a customized system, so it will take time for worker to come up to speed.

Must have strong SAP knowledge, understand fields and how they can be used.

Knowledge of master data is not critical, most data will be OTC, A/R data pricing, customer, pricing tables.

Must have recent SAP experience over the last 3 years.

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.


Local : Remoto

title: Tech Lead - Inteligência Artificial (AI)
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial para liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento de plataformas de agentes de IA , atuando desde a concepção da arquitetura até a entrega e evolução contínua das soluções.

Essa posição é ideal para quem combina excelência técnica , visão arquitetural e capacidade de liderança , com forte interesse em soluções modernas de IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead / Líder Técnico ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio em Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial , Machine Learning ou soluções baseadas em LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços, cloud e arquiteturas modernas.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica e liderança de times de engenharia.

- Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de plataformas de agentes de IA (multiagentes, orquestração, integrações com LLMs).
  • Definir arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar hands-on no desenvolvimento utilizando Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Orientar e mentorar desenvolvedores, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens em Inteligência Artificial.

- Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com plataformas de agentes de IA , RAG, LangChain ou frameworks de orquestração.
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em produtos de dados, IA generativa ou plataformas internas.
  • Boa comunicação e visão estratégica.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de IA , com impacto direto no negócio.
  • Ambiente de alto nível técnico, com autonomia e espaço para inovação.
  • Oportunidade de liderar a construção de soluções modernas e escaláveis de IA.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior RPA UiPath Developer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced UiPath RPA Developer to support and maintain an existing automation ecosystem. This professional will work closely with day-to-day operations, ensuring stability, troubleshooting issues, and enhancing current automation frameworks.

The environment includes multiple automation solutions (80+ use cases) built on internal frameworks, recently migrated to cloud infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

· Maintain and enhance existing UiPath automations

· Perform triage, troubleshooting, debugging, and issue resolution

· Understand current frameworks and improve them over time

· Update and refactor existing workflows

· Ensure stability and performance of attended and unattended bots

· Work with Orchestrator for monitoring and support

· Review and improve documentation and process capture

· Collaborate with business teams on process reviews


Required Skills & Experience

· 5–7+ years of RPA development experience

· Strong hands-on experience with UiPath

· Solid understanding of Selectors, Debugging, Orchestrator, Attended & Unattended automation

· Experience working with internal automation frameworks

· Strong documentation skills

· UiPath Certification

· Fluent English


Nice to Have

· Experience in Finance industry

· Experience working with .NET, Java, Angular, or COBOL systems

· Knowledge of Automation Insights, Maestro, or related tools


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Location: Brazil.

title: Pesquisador em experiência do usuário
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários para entender necessidades e comportamentos.
  • Analisar dados e gerar insights para decisões de produto.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com design, produto e engenharia.
  • Documentar e comunicar resultados de forma clara e objetiva.

O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência em UX Research.
  • Vivência prévia em manufatura ou fabricação de produtos.
  • Experiência com pesquisa aplicada a produtos industriais ou ambientes de produção (diferencial).
  • Conhecimento ou atuação em Service Design (diferencial)

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Engenheiro DevOps Sênior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.

Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de seguros, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Remuneração: Dollar | Full-time

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar na redução de esforço operacional (operational toil), por meio da melhoria de automação , testes e confiabilidade da nossa infraestrutura em AWS e dos nossos pipelines de CI/CD . Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na eliminação de infraestrutura drift e na construção de testes end-to-end , contribuindo diretamente para a estabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência das plataformas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de automação com Terraform , garantindo consistência e evitando infraestrutura drift
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura e pipelines de testes end-to-end
  • Aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD no GitLab para deploys de infraestrutura e aplicações
  • Trabalhar com Terramate para gestão de infraestrutura como código
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para garantir entregas confiáveis e automatizadas

Experiências esperadas

  • Experiencia com infraestrutura em cloud
  • Experiência em produção com Kubernetes , preferencialmente AWS EKS
  • Forte conhecimento em Terraform e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experiência prática com AWS , incluindo EKS, RDS, S3 e serviços correlatos
  • Experiência em programação (perfil generalista é aceitável)
  • Stack utilizada: Python , Node.js e TypeScript
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD
  • GitLab CI é preferencial, mas uma base sólida em programação pode compensar

Ambiente técnico

  • AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e outros serviços essenciais)
  • Terraform e Terramate para gestão de infraestrutura
  • GitLab CI para pipelines de deploy
  • Aplicações majoritariamente em Python (Django, FastAPI)
  • Parte do ecossistema em React, Node.js e TypeScript

Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)

About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.

About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)

About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.

About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

title: Windows Architect (Azure)
description:
Job Title: Azure/Windows Architect

Location: LATAm (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.
  • Design landing zones: Understand customer infra landscape; design and build Azure Landing Zones aligned to business, application, and infrastructure strategies.
  • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.
  • Define end‑to‑end solutions: Realize solution architecture addressing business processes, regulatory needs, quality attributes, and cost efficiency.
  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.

Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.

Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.

Apply today or share profiles at

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + React)
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + React) to join our team and help build scalable, high-performance applications. In this role, you will work primarily on backend development using Java 17 and Spring Boot, while also contributing to modern frontend solutions built with React and related technologies. You will be involved in designing and implementing cloud-native services and APIs, collaborating closely with frontend engineers, QA, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, applying best practices in software architecture, performance, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend services using Java 17 and Spring Boot.
  • Work with React, JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, and related frontend technologies as part of full-stack solutions.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
  • Deploy, manage, and maintain applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Optimize application performance and apply security best practices across services.
  • Partner with frontend developers, QA engineers, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, following best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and support the technical growth of other engineers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues efficiently and responsibly.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience with Java 17 and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Solid experience building backend services and APIs in distributed systems.
  • Strong proficiency in frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, Node.js, and Next.js
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Couchbase, Elastic).
  • Strong understanding of security principles and best practices in backend development.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience with messaging systems such as Solace.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Splunk, New Relic).
  • Exposure to AI-related concepts or tools applied to software development.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: PMO - Projetos de Tecnologia e ERP
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a entregas para atuar como PMO com experiência em WMS, apoiando a gestão e governança de projetos de tecnologia e logística. Você será responsável por estruturar rotinas de acompanhamento, consolidar indicadores, organizar cronogramas e garantir a comunicação entre as áreas, contribuindo para a execução eficiente e a melhoria contínua dos projetos relacionados a Warehouse Management System (WMS).

Local

São Paulo/SP.

Modelo de trabalho

Remoto

Tipo de contratação

PJ

Responsabilidades

✅ Governança e Rotina de Projetos (PMO):

* Estruturar e conduzir rotinas de acompanhamento (status report, comitês, reuniões de alinhamento).

* Controlar e atualizar cronogramas, planos de ação, riscos, issues e dependências.

* Garantir aderência aos processos de governança e padrões de gestão definidos.

✅ Levantamento de Demandas e Requisitos (As Is):

• Realizar o mapeamento de demandas junto aos stakeholders, levantando requisitos funcionais e registrando o cenário atual (AS-IS).

• Documentar o fluxo básico dos processos e apoiar a organização das necessidades do negócio para evolução do projeto.

✅ Gestão de Indicadores e Relatórios:

* Consolidar KPIs do projeto (prazo, escopo, custos, qualidade e status de entregas).

* Elaborar dashboards e relatórios executivos para stakeholders, com clareza e objetividade.

* Apoiar na tomada de decisão por meio de análises e recomendações.

✅ Atuação com Projetos de WMS:

* Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de iniciativas envolvendo implantação, melhorias ou sustentação de WMS.

* Interagir com times de negócio (operações/logística) e TI para alinhamento de requisitos, prioridades e mudanças.

* Garantir rastreabilidade de demandas, entregáveis e documentação do projeto.

✅ Gestão de Stakeholders e Comunicação:

* Facilitar a comunicação entre áreas multidisciplinares, alinhando expectativas e prioridades.

* Apoiar a gestão de mudanças, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento das partes envolvidas.

✅ Qualidade, Testes e Go-live (quando aplicável):

* Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento de testes (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização.

* Organizar evidências, cronogramas e checkpoints para suportar a qualidade das entregas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

✔ Experiência prévia como PMO / Analista de Projetos / Project Analyst em projetos de TI.

✔ Experiência com WMS (implantação, melhorias, rollout ou sustentação), com vivência em ambiente de logística/armazenagem.

✔ Sólida capacidade de controle e gestão de: cronograma, riscos, issues, mudanças e dependências.

✔ Experiência com documentação e organização de entregáveis do projeto.

✔ Conhecimento em gestão de projetos (metodologias tradicionais e/ou ágeis).

✔ Perfil comportamental desejado:

* Organização e senso de dono para garantir cadência e execução.

* Proatividade para antecipar riscos e propor soluções.

* Comunicação clara para interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

* Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados.

* Colaboração com times multidisciplinares e ambientes dinâmicos.

Diferenciais

✚ Vivência com operações de armazém (recebimento, putaway, picking, packing, expedição, inventário).

✚ Experiência com integrações WMS x ERP (ex.: SAP, Oracle, TOTVS, etc.).

✚ Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão e indicadores (Jira/Confluence, MS Project, Power BI, Excel avançado).

✚ Certificações em gestão de projetos e métodos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban, ITIL).

title: Analista de Projetos Contratos de Obras Sr
description:
Você quer participar da transformação do saneamento no Brasil? Buscamos pessoas que, assim como nós, têm vontade de ir além do básico para aplicar seus conhecimentos em um setor que está mudando a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras. Na BRK, respeito, diversidade e inclusão são valores inegociáveis! Atuamos para promover um ambiente positivo, inovador, ético, inclusivo, seguro e de respeito às pessoas.

Se você sempre quis trabalhar com propósito, temos uma oportunidade que pode te interessar:

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o planejamento, desenvolvimento e controle de projetos de investimentos e obras, atuando de forma autônoma e sob supervisão, visando acompanhar o portfólio de projetos e suportar o alcance das metas dos projetos e do negócio.
  • Garantir a eficiência dos projetos, por meio do controle do progresso físico-financeiro, elaborando orçamentos, analisando relatórios de acompanhamento e sugerindo soluções, visando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Assegurar a aderência da carteira de projetos aos respectivos cronogramas físico-financeiros, de acordo com as diretrizes estabelecidas.
  • Assegurar a acuracidade dos dados utilizados na etapa de planejamento, mediante a análise de indicadores técnicos, controle e consolidação dos resultados.
  • Acompanhar indicadores, bem como preparar relatórios e apresentações.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica e/ou Automação
  • MS Project
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • CNH B
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Sumaré SP

O que oferecemos:

Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Vale Refeição ou Alimentação, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Vale Transporte, Programa de Apoio à Saúde, Gympass, DayOff, Licença Maternidade ou Paternidade estendida, PLR; + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.

A BRK é uma das maiores empresas privadas de saneamento do país e está presente em 13 estados e mais de 100 municípios, beneficiando a vida de mais de 16 milhões de pessoas. Investimos e operamos sistemas de água e esgoto, fornecendo um serviço que faz toda a diferença para a saúde e o bem-estar da população.

A BRK e seus acionistas estão comprometidos com um modelo de gestão ESG (da sigla em inglês para Meio Ambiente, Social e Governança), incorporando esta estratégia à tomada de decisões da companhia e à prestação de serviços.

Este é o nosso jeito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuamos e de transformar a vida de milhões de pessoas levando o saneamento para muito além do básico!

VEM SER BRK!

title: Desenvolvedor OCC Sênior - OSF (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono , oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados.

INCREASE THE POWER OF YOUR BUSINESS.

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de OCC / OSF;
  • Desenhar e evoluir arquiteturas de Order Management & Fulfillment;
  • Desenvolver e customizar soluções avançadas em OCC;
  • Modelar, configurar e otimizar workflows em OSF / OSM;
  • Atuar em integrações entre sistemas BSS/OSS (REST, SOAP, mensageria);
  • Realizar análise de impacto e desenho de soluções para novos produtos;
  • Executar troubleshooting avançado e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade dos fluxos de pedido;
  • Atuar em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e missão crítica.

❇️ O que esperamos de você – Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor OCC Sênior;
  • Profundo conhecimento em OSF (Oracle Service Fulfillment) / OSM Framework;
  • Forte atuação em arquitetura de soluções de Order Management;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Conhecimento em REST, SOAP e mensageria;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com práticas DevOps;
  • Atuação em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.

❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de telecomunicações;
  • Atuação em ambientes de grande escala e alto volume transacional.

❇️ O que esperamos de você – Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Liderança técnica e tomada de decisão;
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e áreas funcionais;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e visão sistêmica.

✨ O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$39,71/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);

  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Analista de TI
description:
Na Blue Health , temos um sonho grande: ser referência em soluções inovadoras para equipamentos e consumíveis médicos, democratizando o acesso à saúde na América Latina. Para sustentar nosso crescimento e garantir a excelência das nossas operações, buscamos um Analista de Suporte de TI para atuar como ponto de apoio tecnológico aos nossos colaboradores, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência, inovação e continuidade do negócio.

Será responsável por prestar assistência técnica e oferecer soluções para problemas de tecnologia da informação, atuando como ponto de contato para os usuários finais. Essa pessoa irá apoiar na resolução de questões relacionadas a hardware, software, redes e sistemas. Buscamos alguém apaixonado por tecnologia, inovação e que esteja sempre em busca de melhorias para o cenário atual.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atender usuários finais (nível N1);
  • Desmontar, montar e diagnosticar problemas em laptops e CPUs;
  • Atuar com cabeamento de rede em nível básico;
  • Realizar instalação e configuração de periféricos de rede (switches, impressoras e scanners);
  • Criar, alterar, bloquear e excluir usuários da rede e e-mails corporativos;
  • Instalar e configurar novos equipamentos (notebooks, desktops e smartphones);
  • Instalar e configurar softwares e sistemas operacionais (Windows 10, Office 365, entre outros).

Buscamos alguém com:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia como Analista de Suporte de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ambiente Windows;
  • Conhecimento em redes;
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Inglês básico;
  • Conhecimento básico de eletrônica;
  • Experiência com Linux;
  • Conhecimento em programação.

O que oferecemos de benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação no cartão Swile no valor de R$ 885,00
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência Médica da Amil
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Wellhub
  • Auxílio Farmácia
  • Clube de Descontos (lojas e restaurantes)
  • Programa de Saúde Mental

title: Lead Data Architect - Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation

Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices

Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: Lead Data Architect - Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation

Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark

  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git

Soft Skills

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Tech Lead - Python

A Shipay simplifica a forma de as empresas receberem e pagarem por meios digitais, como Pix, Bolepix e Carteiras Digitais. Com a regulamentação da Duplicata Escritural, vamos viabilizar o Pagamento em Duas Etapas, além de um hub de escrituração de duplicatas. 

Buscamos um(a) Líder Técnico(a) para guiar nossa equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e eficientes. Importante: Este papel foca na excelência tecnológica e mentoria técnica, não sendo responsável pela gestão de pessoas .

Responsabilidades

  • Excelência Técnica: Projetar, implementar e testar serviços de back-end de forma iterativa, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Desenvolvimento Ativo: Atuar de forma \"hands-on\" no desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas e assíncronas, sendo a referência técnica para o time nas entregas das sprints.
  • Padrões e Práticas: Definir e implementar as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Realizar estimativas de projetos, identificar riscos técnicos e criar planos de mitigação para débitos técnicos.
  • Mentoria e Resolução: Atuar como mentor técnico para o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe e resolver problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com a gestão para garantir a eficiência das entregas nos times.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Python: Domínio em desenvolvimento utilizando Python, Flask, FastAPI e SqlAlchemy.
  • Arquitetura: Sólida experiência com Programação Orientada a Objetos, Modelagem de Dados e arquitetura de microsserviços em ambiente Cloud.
  • Qualidade de Software: Vivência no desenvolvimento e teste de aplicações distribuídas, assíncronas e aplicação de testes de software.
  • Visão de Engenharia: Experiência na aplicação de Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Habilidade Analítica: Capacidade de realizar estimativas precisas e gerir débitos técnicos de forma estratégica.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Habilidade para depuração e solução de problemas técnicos de alta complexidade.

Benefícios

  • Caju: Flexibilidade VR/VA em um só cartão.
  • Bônus: Até 2,5 salários por performance (individual e da empresa).
  • Saúde: Plano Porto Seguro.
  • Odonto: Plano Metlife.
  • Filhos: Auxílio-creche.
  • Segurança: Seguro de vida.
  • Desenvolvimento: Acesso Alura (plataforma de aprendizado).
  • Família: Licenças maternidade/paternidade estendidas (Empresa Cidadã).
  • Day-off: Folga para comemorar o seu aniversário.

Local de Trabalho

  • 100% Remoto .
  • Caso prefira, nosso escritório em São Paulo (próximo das estações Anhangabaú e São Bento) está disponível para uso.

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for over 115 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to
